name: evh_match
description: eVHarmony v4 (round 17o, owner request): v3 unchanged (same attributes, options and values, so v3 answers carry over), plus nick: the reviewer's optional dating name (text, at most 24 characters), saved once per reviewer on the set's first item (as consent), for a lab scoreboard.

object_attrs.label: Match?
object_attrs.help: Swipe right = Match (a membrane-bound vesicle, overlapping ones too), left = Nope, up = It's complicated (anything not clearly yes or no).

object_attrs.label: What is it?
object_attrs.help: Only after a Match, optional. Multilayer: any part of one (outer ring, inner layer).

object_attrs.label: Outline off
object_attrs.help: Only after a Match, optional: the right object, but its outline needs correcting.

object_attrs.label: Count my answers
object_attrs.help: Asked once, on the set's first item: yes = these answers may be used.

object_attrs.label: Dating name
object_attrs.help: Optional, on the set's first item only: the name shown on a lab scoreboard.
